caption: Figure 2: Logical processes spread across machines. Each logical process is comprised of proclets that include a heap (shown as a circle) and threads (shown as squiggles). Proclets rapidly migrate to other machines in response to resource pressure.
subject: how one proclet migrates from Machine 0 to Machine 1 while other proclets in the same logical process stay put

groups.why_chosen: Because a proclet already bundles its own heap and threads as a self-contained partition, migrating it between machines is just relocating that unit, not a special operation.
groups.what_to_learn: Before and after in one frame: dashed ghost at the old slot, curved arrow, red operation label
